newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Northwest, Garuda form Indonesia alliance.
newsitem.headline: Northwest, Garuda form Indonesia alliance.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Inc said on Monday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with Indonesia's national airline Garuda for flights between the United States and Indonesia.
Northwest said it was to fly three times a week between Seattle, Osaka and Jakarta -- the first service by a U.S. airline to the Indonesian capital.

The memorandum of understanding aims to achieve coordination of flight schedules and a connection between route networks and code sharing as well as links between reservation systems, frequent flyer programmes and promotions.
Northwest said in a statement issued both in Amsterdam and Minneapolis, the flights to Indonesia form a part of its long-term growth strategy in Asia.
KLM Royal Dutch Airlines has a partnership with Northwest involving a minority shareholding in the U.S. carrier by the Dutch airline.
